# Artificial Intelligence

Menlo is **ALL IN on AI.** Artificial intelligence is breaking into every software vertical, and the winners are creating massive economic and societal value.

## What we do

### Backing the Most Promising AI Companies

Menlo Ventures has been at the forefront of AI, investing across the stack—from infrastructure and foundational models to transformative applications in enterprise, consumer, and healthcare. Our team stands out with a potent combination of deep technical expertise and operational experience, giving us an edge in identifying and supporting the next wave of AI-native companies.

## ALL IN on AI

We’re not just observing the AI era unfold. We’re shaping what comes next.
